build_sinusoidal_embedding: build sinusoidal embeddings for a given number of embeddings and embedding dimension
create_sinusoidal_positional_embedding: create a SinusoidalPositionalEmbedding module that produces sinusoidal positional embeddings of any length
create_learned_positional_embedding: create a LearnedPositionalEmbedding module that learns positional embeddings up to a fixed maximum size
build_positional_embedding: build a positional embedding module using the specified type, combine strategy, and dimensions
review_positional_embedding_types: review the PostionalEmbedType and PostionalEmbedCombine enums for learned, sinusoidal, and hybrid embedding options
